errata.quote: Matrice de processus illustrant trois exemples de processus
errata.evidence: The matrix under this caption has four rows, A to D: patient management, immunization management, stock management and service delivery. The list of figures repeats the caption's count of three.

narrative.text: The French caption of Figure 3.1.1.1 says the process matrix shows three sample processes, but the matrix lists four (A-D).
